name: Guru Har Rai
contribution: The seventh of ten Gurus of the Sikh religion.
legacy: He started several public singing and scripture recital traditions in Sikhism.
image_credit: Seu-Nainsukh workshop of Guler · Public domain

checks.lead: Guru Har Rai (Gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ, pronunciation: [gʊɾuː ɦəɾ ɾaːɪ]; 16 January 1630 – 6 October 1661) revered as the seventh Nanak, was the seventh of ten Gurus of the Sikh religion. He became the Sikh leader at age 14, on 3 March 1644, after the death of his grandfather and the sixth Sikh leader Guru Hargobind. He guided the Sikhs for about seventeen years, till his death at age 31.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
